name: handoff-board
description: Handoff board: browse every project, session and handoff document written by codex-quota-guard, in one panel.

interface.shortDescription: Project / session / handoff browser for Codex
interface.longDescription: Reads ~/.codex/sessions rollouts and every <project>/.handoff/<utc>-<slug>/ pair written by codex-quota-guard, then renders one panel grouped by project, session and handoff document. Opens from the global desktop sidebar, inline as a visualization, or as a standalone local web panel.
defaultPrompt: Show my handoff board for this project
